scientific_impact: none on the reported values; DEV-03 narrows what the values mean

deviations.reason: The plan's column set requires 8 columns once BARR executes. A single two-figure split by arm cannot show the paired Global and BARR panels for the same case. Splitting by cohort instead keeps the 8 pre-registered columns legible at print resolution.
deviations.effect_on_results: none - same cases, same metrics, same palette

deviations.planned: Stones rows: median / best / worst Dice, largest and smallest non-empty ground-truth lesion
deviations.actual: the same five rows; an additional stone-positive median row was attempted but resolved to a case already selected, so it was deduplicated and the figure keeps five rows
deviations.reason: The cohort-wide median Dice for Stones is 0 because 14 of 20 cases have an empty ground truth. That is the headline finding, so the row is kept rather than substituted; a stone-positive median was added only if it was a distinct case.
deviations.effect_on_results: none - no case was added or removed

deviations.planned: The manuscript protocol (§9.1) defines NSD at tau = 1.0 mm and reports HD95 in millimetres.
deviations.actual: External NSD is computed at tau = 2 pixels and external HD95/ASSD are reported in pixels.
deviations.reason: No external cohort ships physical pixel spacing: CVC-ClinicDB, BrEaST-Lesions-USG and Stones all provide pixel arrays with no DICOM header, calibration phantom or documented mm-per-pixel. A millimetre figure would be fabricated. The plan pre-registered the pixel convention (section 6.1) for exactly this reason.
deviations.effect_on_results: External surface metrics are not comparable to internal millimetre values and not comparable across the three cohorts. Every document states the unit next to the number.
